sources.instructions: Steam app 2915550 is anonymous and Windows-only. Stage FoundryDedicatedServer.exe and its Unity data, or let setup download that depot. On Linux, AlphaGSM launches the Windows executable with Wine. Do not rename the executable and claim a native Linux build.
